say:0:1122102001:0.text: So many bounty hunters here! Why have they all gathered? Is there some sort of event going on?
say:0:1122102001:0.source_cn: 好多赏金猎人啊！他们怎么都聚在这里，是有什么活动吗？

say:1:1122102002:0.text: There seems to be a strange bounty posted on the notice board.
say:1:1122102002:0.source_cn: 听他们的意思，好像是告示板上出现了一个奇怪的悬赏。

say:1:1122103001:1.text: Lemme tell ya, this bounty from the Buckthorn Caravan ain't that simple. Don't rush to accept it.
say:1:1122103001:1.source_cn: 嘿，提醒你们一句，红沙棘商队的悬赏令没那么简单，别急着去接。

say:3:1122103002:1.text: Ah! M-Magister, it's that bounty hunter we met when we first arrived in Alkali! He's come to take revenge on us!
say:3:1122103002:1.source_cn: 哇啊！主……主人，是我们刚来咸水镇上遇到的那个赏金猎人...
say:3:1122103002:1.male: Ah! M-Magister, it's that bounty hunter we met when we first arrived in Alkali! He's come to take revenge on us!
say:3:1122103002:1.female: Ah! M-Magister, it's that bounty hunter we met when we first arrived in Alkali! He's come to take revenge on us!

say:4:1122103003:1.text: Seems you aren't too sharp, huh? If I wanted revenge, I had plenty of chances before now.
say:4:1122103003:1.source_cn: 看来你这小脑袋不太灵光啊。我要是想报仇，多的是机会出手...

say:6:1122103004:1.text: This time, I've come to discuss a partnership with you, <style="stress"><player_name></style>.
say:6:1122103004:1.source_cn: 老实说吧，我这次是来和你——<style=stress...
say:6:1122103004:1.male: This time, I've come to discuss a partnership with you, <style="stress"><player_name></style>.
say:6:1122103004:1.female: This time, I've come to discuss a partnership with you, <style="stress"><player_name></style>.

say:7:1122103005:1.text: Last time we fought, and although you're still a bit weaker than me, you've caught my eye.
say:7:1122103005:1.source_cn: 上次交手，虽然你的实力还是比我差了一点，但也足够也让我...
say:7:1122103005:1.male: Last time we fought, and although you're still a bit weaker than me, you've caught my eye.
say:7:1122103005:1.female: Last time we fought, and although you're still a bit weaker than me, you've caught my eye.

say:8:1122103006:1.text: With your combat skills, teaming up with an experienced bounty hunter like me could lead to big things!
say:8:1122103006:1.source_cn: 以你的战斗力，如果能和我这样经验丰富的赏金猎人合作，肯...
say:8:1122103006:1.male: With your combat skills, teaming up with an experienced bounty hunter like me could lead to big things!
say:8:1122103006:1.female: With your combat skills, teaming up with an experienced bounty hunter like me could lead to big things!

say:9:1122103007:1.text: And like I said, the Buckthorn Caravan's bounty is quite risky. It definitely isn't something you can handle alone.
say:9:1122103007:1.source_cn: 相信你也看出来了，就像我说的那样，红沙棘的悬赏很危险，...
say:9:1122103007:1.male: And like I said, the Buckthorn Caravan's bounty is quite risky. It definitely isn't something you can handle alone.
say:9:1122103007:1.female: And like I said, the Buckthorn Caravan's bounty is quite risky. It definitely isn't something you can handle alone.

say:11:1122103008:1.text: Why? Don't they just want to recover their lost items?
say:11:1122103008:1.source_cn: 为什么？他们明明只是想找回丢失的东西啊！

choice_prompt:12:1122103008.text: Why? Don't they just want to recover their lost items?
choice_prompt:12:1122103008.source_cn: 为什么？他们明明只是想找回丢失的东西啊！

say:13:1122103009:2.text: Exactly. Offering such a high price to simply retrieve some lost items means that those items must be super valuable.
say:13:1122103009:2.source_cn: 没错。开大价钱只为寻回失物，可想而知，这批东西该有多值钱。

say:14:1122103010:1.text: Compared to all the other bounty hunters in Alkali, my skills are top-notch, and I've got some reliable buddies too.
say:14:1122103010:1.source_cn: 咸水镇上这么多赏金猎人，我的本事绝对数一数二，更别提我...

say:15:1122103011:1.text: How about it? Wanna join forces with me?
say:15:1122103011:1.source_cn: 怎么样？考虑一下和我合作？
say:15:1122103011:1.male: How about it? Wanna join forces with me?
say:15:1122103011:1.female: How about it? Wanna join forces with me?

choice_prompt:16:1122103011.text: How about it? Wanna join forces with me?
choice_prompt:16:1122103011.source_cn: 怎么样？考虑一下和我合作？
choice_prompt:16:1122103011.male: How about it? Wanna join forces with me?
choice_prompt:16:1122103011.female: How about it? Wanna join forces with me?

say:17:1122103016:1.text: Now that I've got your agreement... Come to our base!
say:17:1122103016:1.source_cn: 我姑且当你答应了。\n走吧，跟我去基地看看。
say:17:1122103016:1.male: Now that I've got your agreement... Come to our base!
say:17:1122103016:1.female: Now that I've got your agreement... Come to our base!

choice:16:0:1.text: It's worth a try, I guess...
choice:16:0:1.male: It's worth a try, I guess...
choice:16:0:1.female: It's worth a try, I guess...

say:20:1122103013:1.text: It's the same as I said last time. If you want to move around in Alkali, you're bound to deal with us. Cooperation beats animosity any day.
say:20:1122103013:1.source_cn: 还是那个道理——想在咸水镇上混，免不了要和我们打交道。...
say:20:1122103013:1.male: It's the same as I said last time. If you want to move around in Alkali, you're bound to deal with us. Cooperation beats animosity any day.
say:20:1122103013:1.female: It's the same as I said last time. If you want to move around in Alkali, you're bound to deal with us. Cooperation beats animosity any day.

choice:16:1:2.source_cn: 我一个人就可以，不需要你

say:21:1122103014:1.text: That was how it was for the previous treasure! But hey, I'd like to think we're closer now. New bounty, new rules! You'll definitely get a fair share.
say:21:1122103014:1.source_cn: 那是高原宝藏的分成规矩，新悬赏，新规矩！少不了你的。
say:21:1122103014:1.male: That was how it was for the previous treasure! But hey, I'd like to think we're closer now. New bounty, new rules! You'll definitely get a fair share.
say:21:1122103014:1.female: That was how it was for the previous treasure! But hey, I'd like to think we're closer now. New bounty, new rules! You'll definitely get a fair share.

say:22:1122103015:1.text: And of course, your future cut depends on how much you contribute to the mission. Anyways...
say:22:1122103015:1.source_cn: 以后能分多少，还要看你在委托里做了多少贡献。
say:22:1122103015:1.male: And of course, your future cut depends on how much you contribute to the mission. Anyways...
say:22:1122103015:1.female: And of course, your future cut depends on how much you contribute to the mission. Anyways...

say:0:1122104001:0.text: Now that you're with us, this team is finally shaping up.
say:0:1122104001:0.source_cn: 加上你，这个小队总算是成形了。
say:0:1122104001:0.male: Now that you're with us, this team is finally shaping up.
say:0:1122104001:0.female: Now that you're with us, this team is finally shaping up.

say:1:1122104002:0.text: Never thought you'd be the last recruit I'd take on for this bounty.
say:1:1122104002:0.source_cn: 真没想到，你会是我招募到的最后一个成员。
say:1:1122104002:0.male: Never thought you'd be the last recruit I'd take on for this bounty.
say:1:1122104002:0.female: Never thought you'd be the last recruit I'd take on for this bounty.

say:0:1122105001:0.text: Here's our base. By the way, meet Wildclaw and Grayhorn.
say:0:1122105001:0.source_cn: 就是这里了，我们的基地。顺便认识一下，烈爪和老憨。
say:0:1122105001:0.male: Here's our base. By the way, meet Wildclaw and Grayhorn.
say:0:1122105001:0.female: Here's our base. By the way, meet Wildclaw and Grayhorn.

say:1:1122105002:0.text: Since you're new, I'll need to get you up to speed. Come find me when you're ready.
say:1:1122105002:0.source_cn: 你是新人，我得帮你做些准备。等你有空了就来找我。
say:1:1122105002:0.male: Since you're new, I'll need to get you up to speed. Come find me when you're ready.
say:1:1122105002:0.female: Since you're new, I'll need to get you up to speed. Come find me when you're ready.

say:1:1122106001:1.text: Wildclaw and I already acknowledge your skills, <style="stress"><player_name></style>.
say:1:1122106001:1.male: Wildclaw and I already acknowledge your skills, <style="stress"><player_name></style>.
say:1:1122106001:1.female: Wildclaw and I already acknowledge your skills, <style="stress"><player_name></style>.

say:2:1122106002:1.text: But to be honest, you're not a full-fledged bounty hunter yet.
say:2:1122106002:1.source_cn: 但坦白来说，你还称不上是一位赏金猎人。
say:2:1122106002:1.male: But to be honest, you're not a full-fledged bounty hunter yet.
say:2:1122106002:1.female: But to be honest, you're not a full-fledged bounty hunter yet.

choice_prompt:3:1122106002.text: But to be honest, you're not a full-fledged bounty hunter yet.
choice_prompt:3:1122106002.source_cn: 但坦白来说，你还称不上是一位赏金猎人。
choice_prompt:3:1122106002.male: But to be honest, you're not a full-fledged bounty hunter yet.
choice_prompt:3:1122106002.female: But to be honest, you're not a full-fledged bounty hunter yet.

say:4:1122106003:2.text: Hmph, don't underestimate what goes on behind the scenes.
say:4:1122106003:2.source_cn: 哼，你可别小瞧了赏金猎人的工作。
say:4:1122106003:2.male: Hmph, don't underestimate what goes on behind the scenes.
say:4:1122106003:2.female: Hmph, don't underestimate what goes on behind the scenes.

say:5:1122106004:1.text: We've handled all sorts of bounties, from the mundane, like finding lost pets, to serious ones, like clearing out bandits... It's not easy to excel at everything!
say:5:1122106004:1.source_cn: 无论什么委托都能完成，小到找猫遛狗，大到清匪开路……想...

say:7:1122106005:1.text: You've even gone against bandits? Couldn't tell... Chippy thought you guys survived off collecting information fees in Alkali!
say:7:1122106005:1.source_cn: 你们还做过清除盗匪的工作？真看不出来……满满还以为你们...

say:8:1122106006:1.text: Hey, that's how Alkali's always been run! It's been like that before we even arrived, we just follow the rules.
say:8:1122106006:1.source_cn: 那是咸水镇的规矩，早在我们来之前就定下来了！我们只是照...

say:10:1122106007:1.text: Hang on, let's stay on topic. <style="stress"><player_name></style>, we gotta get you trained up.
say:10:1122106007:1.male: Hang on, let's stay on topic. <style="stress"><player_name></style>, we gotta get you trained up.
say:10:1122106007:1.female: Hang on, let's stay on topic. <style="stress"><player_name></style>, we gotta get you trained up.

choice_prompt:11:1122106007.text: Hang on, let's stay on topic. <style="stress"><player_name></style>, we gotta get you trained up.
choice_prompt:11:1122106007.source_cn: 哎，别转移话题了。\n<style=stress><player_name></style>，我们得对你进行训练。
choice_prompt:11:1122106007.male: Hang on, let's stay on topic. <style="stress"><player_name></style>, we gotta get you trained up.
choice_prompt:11:1122106007.female: Hang on, let's stay on topic. <style="stress"><player_name></style>, we gotta get you trained up.

say:12:1122106008:1.text: Who else do you see here? I'll teach you the essential skills every bounty hunter needs!
say:12:1122106008:1.source_cn: 没错，我会教给你赏金猎人必须掌握的技能！
say:12:1122106008:1.male: Who else do you see here? I'll teach you the essential skills every bounty hunter needs!
say:12:1122106008:1.female: Who else do you see here? I'll teach you the essential skills every bounty hunter needs!

say:13:1122106010:1.text: Feel honored. Me, Silverbeak, the most renowned bounty hunter in the Eroded Enclave, has chosen to personally teach you!
say:13:1122106010:1.source_cn: 感到荣幸吧——我，银喙，风蚀飞地最威名远扬的赏金猎人，...
say:13:1122106010:1.male: Feel honored. Me, Silverbeak, the most renowned bounty hunter in the Eroded Enclave, has chosen to personally teach you!
say:13:1122106010:1.female: Feel honored. Me, Silverbeak, the most renowned bounty hunter in the Eroded Enclave, has chosen to personally teach you!

say:15:1122106011:1.text: Um... If this were the Serene Lyceum, you wouldn't even qualify as one of <style="stress"><player_name></style>'s students...
say:15:1122106011:1.source_cn: 呃……要是放在莱希拉姆，你连给<style=stres...
say:15:1122106011:1.male: Um... If this were the Serene Lyceum, you wouldn't even qualify as one of <style="stress"><player_name></style>'s students...
say:15:1122106011:1.female: Um... If this were the Serene Lyceum, you wouldn't even qualify as one of <style="stress"><player_name></style>'s students...

say:16:1122106012:1.text: Serene what? Pshaw, never heard of it! Sounds peaceful, I bet it's some tiny school somewhere near the edges!
say:16:1122106012:1.source_cn: 什么莱希拉姆……听都没听说过！又是哪个地方的小学校吧。

say:18:1122106013:1.text: Enough talk, let's get to training!
say:18:1122106013:1.source_cn: 行了，别扯那么多，得抓紧时间训练你们了。

say:19:1122106014:1.text: Let's start with the first task, finding an animal.
say:19:1122106014:1.source_cn: 就先从这个任务开始吧——捕捉宠物。

say:20:1122106015:1.text: The client is the owner of the rest station, <style="highlight">Donne</style>. Go ask him for the details of the bounty, the rest station is at the <style="highlight">northeast corner of Alkali</style>.
say:20:1122106015:1.male: The client is the owner of the rest station, <style="highlight">Donne</style>. Go ask him for the details of the bounty, the rest station is at the <style="highlight">northeast corner of Alkali</style>.
say:20:1122106015:1.female: The client is the owner of the rest station, <style="highlight">Donne</style>. Go ask him for the details of the bounty, the rest station is at the <style="highlight">northeast corner of Alkali</style>.

say:22:1122106009:1.text: Ha! That's the attitude I like! When I'm done with you, you'll be walking around like any other bounty hunter in Alkali!
say:22:1122106009:1.source_cn: 没有理论，赏金猎人的技巧全都来源于经验。

choice:3:1:2.source_cn: 这话从你们嘴里说出来好没说服力

say:2:1122107001:1.text: Are you the ones who took my commission? It's about time you came.
say:2:1122107001:1.source_cn: 你就是接了我委托的人？可算是来了，真是让我好等。
say:2:1122107001:1.male: Are you the ones who took my commission? It's about time you came.
say:2:1122107001:1.female: Are you the ones who took my commission? It's about time you came.

choice_prompt:3:1122107001.text: Are you the ones who took my commission? It's about time you came.
choice_prompt:3:1122107001.source_cn: 你就是接了我委托的人？可算是来了，真是让我好等。
choice_prompt:3:1122107001.male: Are you the ones who took my commission? It's about time you came.
choice_prompt:3:1122107001.female: Are you the ones who took my commission? It's about time you came.

say:4:1122107002:1.text: Yeah! You didn't even write down the most important thing: what kind of animal you want us to find!
say:4:1122107002:1.source_cn: 是啊！你连最重要的事情——要捕捉什么动物，都没有写上！

say:5:1122107003:1.text: Oh! Gosh, look at my memory. I forget everything when I'm busy.
say:5:1122107003:1.source_cn: 嗬！瞧瞧我这记性，一忙起来什么都忘了。

say:6:1122107004:1.text: I'm looking for a terrabird, a small and cute one. Preferably a <style="highlight">baby terrabird</style>!
say:6:1122107004:1.source_cn: 我想要的是陆行鸟，又小又可爱的那种<style=hig...

say:7:1122107006:1.text: Lately, there have been many foreign merchants who have come to Alkali to buy small terrabirds. They're oh so cute! I decided I wanted one too, but by then, all the terrabird tamers had already sold out of them...
say:7:1122107006:1.source_cn: 最近这镇上，有不少外来的商人都买了小陆行鸟，我瞅着确实...

say:8:1122107007:1.text: That only left me with one option, which is to ask you bounty hunters to help...
say:8:1122107007:1.source_cn: 没办法，只能请你们这些赏金猎人帮忙了。

say:9:1122107008:1.text: Remember, I want the healthiest and cutest little terrabird! The reward price is negotiable!
say:9:1122107008:1.source_cn: 千万记住，我要最健康最可爱的小陆行鸟！价钱好说！

choice:3:0:1.text: You didn't give us much info.
choice:3:0:1.source_cn: 你的委托单写得不太清楚
choice:3:0:1.male: You didn't give us much info.
choice:3:0:1.female: You didn't give us much info.

say:11:1122107005:1.text: I want a terrabird, a <style="highlight">baby terrabird</style>.

choice:3:1:2.text: What kind of animal do you want?
choice:3:1:2.male: What kind of animal do you want?
choice:3:1:2.female: What kind of animal do you want?

say:0:1122108001:0.text: Capturing a terrabird... This job seems easy-peasy!
say:0:1122108001:0.source_cn: 抓陆行鸟……果然是和找猫遛狗差不多的委托。

say:1:1122108002:0.text: Even super duper easy jobs like this are given to bounty hunters! And Chippy thought that Wildclaw might've been lying.
say:1:1122108002:0.source_cn: 原来这么简单的事也会找赏金猎人来做啊，满满还以为烈爪说...

say:2:1122108003:0.text: First, let's go back and tell Silverbeak the details.
say:2:1122108003:0.source_cn: 先把具体的委托内容告诉银喙吧。
say:2:1122108003:0.male: First, let's go back and tell Silverbeak the details.
say:2:1122108003:0.female: First, let's go back and tell Silverbeak the details.

say:1:1122109001:1.text: Capturng a baby terrabird? Just as I expected. This won't be a tough first job for you.
say:1:1122109001:1.source_cn: 要抓陆行鸟幼崽？果然和我想的差不多，没什么难度。

say:2:1122109002:1.text: Good! This bounty suits you perfectly, newbie.
say:2:1122109002:1.source_cn: 正好，这个委托很适合现在的你。
say:2:1122109002:1.male: Good! This bounty suits you perfectly, newbie.
say:2:1122109002:1.female: Good! This bounty suits you perfectly, newbie.

say:4:1122109003:1.text: W-what?! Giving such a simple task to one such as our magister is a complete waste of talent!!
say:4:1122109003:1.source_cn: 这么简单的任务，让主人去做简直是大材小用——！
say:4:1122109003:1.male: W-what?! Giving such a simple task to one such as our magister is a complete waste of talent!!
say:4:1122109003:1.female: W-what?! Giving such a simple task to one such as our magister is a complete waste of talent!!

say:6:1122109004:1.text: Not every job has to be intense treasure seeking! You can make money by doing small tasks like this. You gotta put food on the table after all.
say:6:1122109004:1.source_cn: 别说你主人了，即使是让老憨去做这份委托，也是浪费。
say:6:1122109004:1.male: Not every job has to be intense treasure seeking! You can make money by doing small tasks like this. You gotta put food on the table after all.
say:6:1122109004:1.female: Not every job has to be intense treasure seeking! You can make money by doing small tasks like this. You gotta put food on the table after all.

say:7:1122109005:1.text: And come now, I have better things to do with my time. This would be a waste even for Grayhorn, and he's, y'know... So times like this are when a newbie like you should step up!
say:7:1122109005:1.source_cn: 但是没办法。振奋人心的悬赏不是每天都有，还是实打实的赏...

say:9:1122109006:1.text: ... What are you saying? You implying I can't even capture a terrabird?!
say:9:1122109006:1.source_cn: ……你什么意思？是说我比你们都差呗？

say:10:1122109007:1.text: Alright, enough squabbling, you two! Continue guarding our base here.
say:10:1122109007:1.source_cn: 行了，别为这点小事争论个没完。你们两个，在这看守基地。

say:12:1122109008:1.text: And <style="stress"><player_name></style>, come with me. I know where we can find baby terrabirds.
say:12:1122109008:1.male: And <style="stress"><player_name></style>, come with me. I know where we can find baby terrabirds.
say:12:1122109008:1.female: And <style="stress"><player_name></style>, come with me. I know where we can find baby terrabirds.

say:1:1122111001:1.text: Pshaw. You're stumped by just a few terrabirds?
say:1:1122111001:1.source_cn: 区区几只陆行鸟，就把你难住了？
say:1:1122111001:1.male: Pshaw. You're stumped by just a few terrabirds?
say:1:1122111001:1.female: Pshaw. You're stumped by just a few terrabirds?

say:2:1122111002:1.text: Lesson number one of being a bounty hunter! Efficiency above all else! Time is precious, after all.
say:2:1122111002:1.source_cn: 赏金猎人的第一课——效率至上！不要把时间浪费在毫无意义...

say:3:1122111003:1.text: Times like this, you gotta think about what tools can help you. Traps, for example.
say:3:1122111003:1.source_cn: 像现在这种情况，你应该想想有没有什么辅助道具可以用。比...
say:3:1122111003:1.male: Times like this, you gotta think about what tools can help you. Traps, for example.
say:3:1122111003:1.female: Times like this, you gotta think about what tools can help you. Traps, for example.

say:5:1122111004:1.text: Duh, you're stating the obvious! But these terrabirds are still babies, regular traps could hurt them!
say:5:1122111004:1.source_cn: 我们当然知道要用陷阱！但这里的陆行鸟都是幼鸟，随随便便...

say:6:1122111005:1.text: Well, that just means you picked the wrong tools!
say:6:1122111005:1.source_cn: 哼，那只能说明，你们挑选的道具不对。

say:7:1122111006:1.text: The right tools can make your job twice as easy, while the wrong tools will just make you look silly.
say:7:1122111006:1.source_cn: 合适的道具可以让行动事半功倍，不合适的道具却只会弄巧成拙。

say:9:1122111007:1.text: Do you have a trap that can catch terrabirds without hurting them?
say:9:1122111007:1.source_cn: 难道你有既能抓住陆行鸟，又不伤害它们的陷阱吗？

say:10:1122111008:1.text: Have you even seen me?! Of course I'm always prepared for any situation!

say:11:1122111009:1.text: There's a fair bit of <style="highlight">tumbleweed</style> in the Eroded Enclave. This plant is sturdy and would make a trap that isn't harmful to small animals.
say:11:1122111009:1.source_cn: 风蚀飞地上经常出现<style=highlight>风...

choice_prompt:12:1122111009.text: There's a fair bit of <style="highlight">tumbleweed</style> in the Eroded Enclave. This plant is sturdy and would make a trap that isn't harmful to small animals.
choice_prompt:12:1122111009.source_cn: 风蚀飞地上经常出现<style=highlight>风滚草</style>。这种植物韧性很强，也没什么杀伤力，最适合制作动物捕捉的陷阱。

say:13:1122111010:1.text: Ha! It's about time you finally appreciate my wisdom.
say:13:1122111010:1.source_cn: 看来你已经领悟到这节课的精髓了。
say:13:1122111010:1.male: Ha! It's about time you finally appreciate my wisdom.
say:13:1122111010:1.female: Ha! It's about time you finally appreciate my wisdom.

say:14:1122111012:1.text: Now go gather some <style="highlight">tumbleweed</style>. Leave the trap-making to me.
say:14:1122111012:1.source_cn: 接下来就去收集<style=highlight>风滚草...

say:16:1122111011:1.text: Well aren't you a confident one? Still, it's about time you appreciate my wisdom.
say:16:1122111011:1.source_cn: 看你胸有成竹的样子，我就已经猜到了。
say:16:1122111011:1.male: Well aren't you a confident one? Still, it's about time you appreciate my wisdom.
say:16:1122111011:1.female: Well aren't you a confident one? Still, it's about time you appreciate my wisdom.

choice:12:1:2.text: I was just about to suggest that.
choice:12:1:2.male: I was just about to suggest that.
choice:12:1:2.female: I was just about to suggest that.

say:0:1122112001:0.text: Whew, we got a ton of tumbleweed! This should be enough, right?
say:0:1122112001:0.source_cn: 收集了这么多风滚草，应该足够了吧？

say:1:1122112002:0.text: Carrying this much tumbleweed makes Chippy feel like he's about to get blown away!
say:1:1122112002:0.source_cn: 唔，抱着这么多风滚草，满满感觉自己也快被风吹跑了……！

say:2:1122113001:1.text: Good. This is enough to make a trap with.
say:2:1122113001:1.source_cn: 很好，有了这些风滚草，就能制作陷阱了。

say:3:1122113002:1.text: Wait here, it won't take long.

narration:4:1122113003:0.text: A short while later, the tumbleweed trap is ready.
narration:4:1122113003:0.source_cn: 没过多久，风滚草陷阱就完成了。

say:5:1122113004:1.text: Hmm... This trap doesn't have any spikes, and the entrance is pretty wide. Will it really catch a baby terrabird?
say:5:1122113004:1.source_cn: 嗯……这种陷阱一个尖刺也没有，入口也很宽敞，真的困得住...

say:6:1122113005:1.text: Don't underestimate a bounty hunter's experience! You'll see it in action soon enough.
say:6:1122113005:1.source_cn: 别瞧不起赏金猎人的经验，你试一试就知道了。

say:7:1122113006:1.text: I'll leave <style="highlight">setting the trap</style> and <style="highlight">luring the terrabird</style> to you, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. Don't let me down!
say:7:1122113006:1.male: I'll leave <style="highlight">setting the trap</style> and <style="highlight">luring the terrabird</style> to you, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. Don't let me down!
say:7:1122113006:1.female: I'll leave <style="highlight">setting the trap</style> and <style="highlight">luring the terrabird</style> to you, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. Don't let me down!

say:0:1122114001:0.text: Put it here. The baby terrabirds should walk right in.
say:0:1122114001:0.source_cn: 放在这个位置，小陆行鸟应该很容易踩中。

say:1:1122114002:0.text: Magister, let's hurry and lure the cutest and healthiest ones in!
say:1:1122114002:0.source_cn: 主人，我们赶快去把小陆行鸟引过来吧！要健康可爱的那些！
say:1:1122114002:0.male: Magister, let's hurry and lure the cutest and healthiest ones in!
say:1:1122114002:0.female: Magister, let's hurry and lure the cutest and healthiest ones in!

say:2:1122115002:1.text: Your performance on this bounty was just about passable.
say:2:1122115002:1.source_cn: 就这份委托而言，你的表现勉强合格。
say:2:1122115002:1.male: Your performance on this bounty was just about passable.
say:2:1122115002:1.female: Your performance on this bounty was just about passable.

say:3:1122115003:1.text: But for a greenhorn bounty hunter, it's not half bad.
say:3:1122115003:1.source_cn: 不过，对于一个初出茅庐的赏金猎人来说，还算不错。
say:3:1122115003:1.male: But for a greenhorn bounty hunter, it's not half bad.
say:3:1122115003:1.female: But for a greenhorn bounty hunter, it's not half bad.

choice_prompt:4:1122115003.text: But for a greenhorn bounty hunter, it's not half bad.
choice_prompt:4:1122115003.source_cn: 不过，对于一个初出茅庐的赏金猎人来说，还算不错。
choice_prompt:4:1122115003.male: But for a greenhorn bounty hunter, it's not half bad.
choice_prompt:4:1122115003.female: But for a greenhorn bounty hunter, it's not half bad.

say:5:1122115004:1.text: Don't thank me, you worked hard on this!
say:5:1122115004:1.male: Don't thank me, you worked hard on this!
say:5:1122115004:1.female: Don't thank me, you worked hard on this!

say:6:1122115006:1.text: I've picked out the best-looking one and released the others. Let's take it to <style="highlight">Donne</style>.
say:6:1122115006:1.source_cn: 我挑了一只品相最好的幼鸟，带去交给<style=hig...

say:7:1122115007:1.text: After completing the bounty, don't forget to bring the reward back to base.
say:7:1122115007:1.source_cn: 完成委托之后，记得把酬金带回基地。
say:7:1122115007:1.male: After completing the bounty, don't forget to bring the reward back to base.
say:7:1122115007:1.female: After completing the bounty, don't forget to bring the reward back to base.

choice:4:0:1.text: Thanks for the praise, I guess?
choice:4:0:1.male: Thanks for the praise, I guess?
choice:4:0:1.female: Thanks for the praise, I guess?

say:9:1122115005:1.text: Of course! No one would ever say I'm lacking as a teacher, ha!
say:9:1122115005:1.male: Of course! No one would ever say I'm lacking as a teacher, ha!
say:9:1122115005:1.female: Of course! No one would ever say I'm lacking as a teacher, ha!

say:1:1122116001:1.text: Oho! Is this the little terrabird you've brought for me? Lemme take a good look!
say:1:1122116001:1.source_cn: 嗬，这就是你抓回来的小陆行鸟？让我仔细瞧瞧！
say:1:1122116001:1.male: Oho! Is this the little terrabird you've brought for me? Lemme take a good look!
say:1:1122116001:1.female: Oho! Is this the little terrabird you've brought for me? Lemme take a good look!

say:2:1122116002:1.text: Hmm. Big bright eyes, glossy feathers, healthy legs... Ouch! This little one scratched my arm! It's a strong little fella.
say:2:1122116002:1.source_cn: 嗯，眼睛又大又亮，羽毛也油光水滑的，这腿更是——嘶，这...

say:3:1122116003:1.text: Not bad at all! This one's gonna be a great partner, I'm pleased.
say:3:1122116003:1.source_cn: 不错，不错！它以后肯定会成为我的好伙伴！我很满意！

say:4:1122116004:1.text: Here's your reward for the commission! When you do business with me, you'll never have to worry about getting paid your worth!
say:4:1122116004:1.source_cn: 这是委托的酬金，你拿走吧！和老迪西伦做生意，永远不用担...
say:4:1122116004:1.male: Here's your reward for the commission! When you do business with me, you'll never have to worry about getting paid your worth!
say:4:1122116004:1.female: Here's your reward for the commission! When you do business with me, you'll never have to worry about getting paid your worth!

say:0:1122118001:0.text: What a ruckus... Sounds like it's coming from Silverbeak's base!
say:0:1122118001:0.source_cn: 前面有争吵声……好像是在银喙的基地里！

say:1:1122118002:0.text: What's going on? Is someone causing trouble?
say:1:1122118002:0.source_cn: 发生了什么？不会是有人来找茬了吧？！

say:1:1122119001:1.text: Ha, a lowlife like Silverbeak still managed to find lackeys? You guys must be idiots, falling for his act!
say:1:1122119001:1.source_cn: 哈，像银喙这种自私自利的混蛋，居然还能招到小弟？你们是...

say:2:1122119002:1.text: Y-you... You're the dumb one! I, Grayhorn, am the sharpest fork in the drawer!
say:2:1122119002:1.source_cn: 你……你才笨！我告诉你，我老憨可是最精明的！

say:3:1122119003:1.text: What does that even mean...? Never mind, I can't get into the mind of fools. How did someone like you even become a bounty hunter? Did Silverbeak con you into it?
say:3:1122119003:1.source_cn: 就你这种货色，怎么当上赏金猎人的？别是银喙把你坑来的吧。

say:4:1122119004:1.text: He's pulled plenty of dirty tricks like that in the past. Betraying partners, selling secrets, stealing loot... What do you see in him?
say:4:1122119004:1.source_cn: 他过去可是做了不少烂事，背叛同伴、出卖情报、侵吞财宝…...

say:6:1122119005:1.text: Lies! I've worked with him for a while now, and I've never seen him do anything like that!
say:6:1122119005:1.source_cn: 胡扯！我和银喙搭档的时间也不短了，从来没见他做过这种事！

say:7:1122119006:1.text: Well, consider yourself lucky you're still useful. Otherwise, he'd have fed you to an ironjaw ages ago.
say:7:1122119006:1.source_cn: 庆幸吧，你的利用价值还不够，不然早就被他丢去喂钢颚兽了。

say:9:1122119007:1.text: Magister... This guy's begging for a fight! Chippy can barely hold back!
say:9:1122119007:1.source_cn: 主人……这个人说话好欠打啊！！满满要忍不住了！！
say:9:1122119007:1.male: Magister... This guy's begging for a fight! Chippy can barely hold back!
say:9:1122119007:1.female: Magister... This guy's begging for a fight! Chippy can barely hold back!

choice_prompt:10:1122119007.text: Magister... This guy's begging for a fight! Chippy can barely hold back!
choice_prompt:10:1122119007.source_cn: 主人……这个人说话好欠打啊！！满满要忍不住了！！
choice_prompt:10:1122119007.male: Magister... This guy's begging for a fight! Chippy can barely hold back!
choice_prompt:10:1122119007.female: Magister... This guy's begging for a fight! Chippy can barely hold back!

say:11:1122119008:1.text: Ha, I didn't expect there would be someone here with common sense.
say:11:1122119008:1.source_cn: 哈，没想到，这还有个明事理的家伙嘛。
say:11:1122119008:1.male: Ha, I didn't expect there would be someone here with common sense.
say:11:1122119008:1.female: Ha, I didn't expect there would be someone here with common sense.

say:12:1122119009:1.text: Let me tell you all about his past...
say:12:1122119009:1.source_cn: 那就让我来聊聊他过去的龌龊事吧……

say:14:1122119011:1.text: Look who finally showed up. I almost thought you chickened out and ran away.
say:14:1122119011:1.source_cn: 哟，终于出现了。我差点以为你害怕得带着包袱逃跑了呢。

say:15:1122119012:1.text: Albert, what are you doing? Ya need money or something? Or are you looking for another beating?
say:15:1122119012:1.source_cn: 艾伯特，你又来闹事干什么！要钱？还是想让我再揍你一顿？

say:16:1122119013:1.text: Why so aggressive? I'm obviously here to collect that debt. Don't be so uptight.
say:16:1122119013:1.source_cn: 上门讨债这么平常的事，别说得那么功利，我的好兄弟。

say:17:1122119014:1.text: And don't forget how you got a cut of the bounty in the first place!
say:17:1122119014:1.source_cn: 也别忘了，当初你是怎么拿到悬赏分成的。

say:18:1122119015:1.text: ... Fine, I'll give you the money. Take it and leave, and stop causing trouble on my turf!
say:18:1122119015:1.source_cn: ……钱，可以给你。但你拿了就滚，少来我的地盘撒野！

say:19:1122119016:1.text: Remember, this settles your debt with me.

narration:21:1122119017:1.text: Albert takes the money pouch Silverbeak tosses at him and swaggers away.

say:23:1122119018:1.text: Silverbeak, what was that?! Why'd you give that sand-eater money after he was just bad-mouthing you?
say:23:1122119018:1.source_cn: 银喙！你为什么要给那个混蛋钱？！他刚才明明就是在污蔑你！

say:24:1122119019:1.text: It's between him and me, stay out of it.
say:24:1122119019:1.source_cn: 我和他之间的恩怨，不关你的事，你少管。

say:28:1122119021:1.text: Very nice. With this money, we can continue building up this base.
say:28:1122119021:1.source_cn: 很好，有了这笔钱，基地的建设就可以提上日程了。

say:29:1122119022:1.text: The first forty percent will be used for base construction, and the remaining sixty percent will be divided based on contributions. This'll be the standard for every bounty from now on.
say:29:1122119022:1.source_cn: 先拿四成出来，用于基地建设，其余的六成再按贡献分配——...

say:31:1122119023:1.text: Forty?! Isn't that a bit much? Chippy's starting to believe what that guy said earlier!
say:31:1122119023:1.source_cn: 四成？！你、你这是不是收得太多了？！满满现在有点相信，...

say:32:1122119024:1.text: This is just a temporary measure! By building the base quickly, we can attract more bounty hunters to join us.
say:32:1122119024:1.source_cn: 这是权宜之计！\n只有尽快建设基地，才会有更多赏金猎人...

say:33:1122119025:1.text: And then we can take on bigger jobs and earn even bigger rewards!
say:33:1122119025:1.source_cn: 到时候，我们才能接更大的委托，赚取更多酬金。

choice_prompt:34:1122119025.text: And then we can take on bigger jobs and earn even bigger rewards!
choice_prompt:34:1122119025.source_cn: 到时候，我们才能接更大的委托，赚取更多酬金。

say:35:1122119027:1.text: Look, most bounty hunters are used to working alone. But when they run into a challenge, they often have nowhere to turn and they're just left standing there blankly. I don't want to risk that anymore.
say:35:1122119027:1.source_cn: 赏金猎人大多习惯独自行动，虽然来去潇洒，可一旦遇到困难...

say:36:1122119028:1.text: Once our base is bigger, maybe we can change things and create a big bounty hunters association.
say:36:1122119028:1.source_cn: 等我们的基地建设起来，也许就能改变现状，让赏金猎人也变...

say:37:1122119029:1.text: And as for funding the base... It's up to you to earn the money needed through bounties!
say:37:1122119029:1.source_cn: 至于建设基地的资金——就指望你们做委托挣来了。

say:38:1122119030:1.text: Seriously?! It all comes down to how much the magister gets from bounties in the end anyway...
say:38:1122119030:1.source_cn: 什么嘛！说来说去还是在算计主人拿到的酬金啊！
say:38:1122119030:1.male: Seriously?! It all comes down to how much the magister gets from bounties in the end anyway...
say:38:1122119030:1.female: Seriously?! It all comes down to how much the magister gets from bounties in the end anyway...

choice:34:0:1.source_cn: 没想到你还挺有计划的

say:40:1122119026:1.text: Pah! I'm not the type to go around borrowing and owing debts everywhere!
say:40:1122119026:1.source_cn: ……呸！我可不是到处赊账欠债的人！

choice:34:1:2.source_cn: 你想赚钱不会是为了还债吧……

choice:27:1:2.text: How are we gonna split it?
choice:27:1:2.male: How are we gonna split it?
choice:27:1:2.female: How are we gonna split it?

choice:10:0:1.source_cn: 他这样说一定有他的理由

cinematic_summary:1.text: You find the treasure Lord Pike mentioned, but Chippy suddenly appears with symptoms of poisoning and paralysis.
cinematic_summary:1.source_cn: 你们挖到了荒矛所说的珍宝，满满却突然出现了中毒麻痹的症状。
